businesses.business: Billboard advertising, broadband and surety insurance

offering_description.value: The company sells space on static and digital billboards to local businesses and national advertisers. It operates fiber and fixed wireless networks that provide internet access to households and businesses. It underwrites and distributes surety bonds for contractors and other businesses.

primary_services.value: Billboard advertising; fiber and fixed wireless internet access; surety bond underwriting and brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Local businesses, national advertisers, advertising agencies, business internet subscribers and contractors seeking surety bonds; B2C: Households buying internet service and individuals seeking license or permit bonds

end_markets.value: Outdoor advertising; residential and business telecommunications; construction and commercial surety

revenue_model.value: advertising: Placements on static and digital billboards; subscription: Recurring charges for residential and business internet access; interest or premiums: Premiums on contract and commercial surety bonds; commissions or management fees: Agency commissions on surety bonds placed with insurers
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates billboards on owned or leased sites and broadband networks serving households and businesses; service provider: Uses billboard inventory to deliver campaigns for advertisers and agencies; financial intermediary: Evaluates bond applications and underwrites or places surety coverage for contractors and other applicants
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide surety distribution, billboards across multiple states and broadband concentrated in Utah and Arizona

specialization.value: diversified: Outdoor advertising, broadband internet and surety insurance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Billboard sales teams and local internet providers; agents / brokers: Independent surety agents and insurance brokers; online: Broadband provider websites and online surety bond applications

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance licensing for surety, FCC broadband rules and state and local billboard permitting

notes: The current scope of the company’s asset management operations is uncertain.
